title: From a repository
help: A public git repository: the commit before a fix and the fix. The fix's tests become the hidden checks.
confirm: Copy this repository and test the fix? The commits and their tests are copied into {{suite}}.
missing: Give the address, both commits and a benchmark.
admitted: Admitted: {{task}} joins {{suite}}. Review its instruction before you run it.
noBenchmarks: Create a benchmark first (From code changes).
